shared_elements: repeated linear signs or geometric patterning
horizontal division into zones or registers
justification: The most specific shared content is the use of schematic profile animals combined with repeated linear signs or patterned bands on a vertically organized decorated surface. The biggest difference is that B centers on a horse-and-rider scene with human figures, weapons/shields, border writing and interlaced serpentine bands, while A shows a different set of isolated animal and abstract motifs arranged in carved registers without the same narrative relationships.
